stance_basis: listed as study funder and IACC/ITC participant with no expressed position for or against any alternative
summary: CalTrans is identified as a co-funder of the study (providing 18% of costs via Proposition 5 fixed guideway funds) and as a participant in both the Inter-Agency Coordinating Committee (IACC) and the Interagency Technical Committee (ITC). The LARTS branch of CalTrans also provided major technical assistance in patronage forecasting. CalTrans is also noted as separately responsible for a Freeway Transit Project (Bus/HOV-ways) that is one of the other elements of the Regional Transportation Development Program, but no position for or against any of the eleven alternatives is attributed to CalTrans in this window.
complaint_summary: CalTrans is listed as a member of the Inter-Agency Coordinating Committee (IACC) with District Director Robert Datel and Chief of Division of Transportation Planning W.E. Schaefer, and also represented on the Interagency Technical Committee by Baxter and Sanchez.
summary_quote: Funding for the study effort has been 80 percent Federal, from UMTA Section 9 grants; 18 percent State, from California Department of Transportation (CalTrans) Proposition 5 fixed guideway funds; and the balance supplied by the Southern California Rapid Transit District.
